calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id<900 AS is_store, s.store_id=999 AS is999, p.category='ZZ Test' AS test, f.vat_rate, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) n, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) dist_ids, count(distinct (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl,
 sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat,
 sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) vat_calc, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(distinct f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS after_change, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH a AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rnet FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) stores, sum(a.net) fact_net, sum(r.rnet) rpt_net, sum(CASE WHEN abs(a.net-r.rnet)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diff_stores, max(abs(a.net-r.rnet)) maxdiff,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM a) na, (SELECT count(*) FROM r) nr
FROM a FULL JOIN r USING (store_id)

calls.statement:
SELECT 'refund' k, r.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) net, sum(r.refund_gross-r.refund_net) vat
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales', f.vat_rate, count(*), sum(f.net_amount), sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 2
ORDER BY 1,2
